reason: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that monitors MiniMax Coding Plan five-hour and weekly quota usage, reset times, and refresh status through the MiniMax API.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏显示 MiniMax Coding Plan 的五小时与每周配额使用量、重置时间和自动刷新的监控插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that displays MiniMax Coding Plan five-hour and weekly quota usage, reset times, and periodically refreshed status.

capabilities: Calls the MiniMax REST API to retrieve quota usage
Exposes a local quota endpoint for the client
Displays five-hour and weekly quota progress in the sidebar
Refreshes quota data every 60 seconds using server-side caching
